text:
kevin: Quick thread  planning sync for Orchestrator + Gateway + LangChain packaging into marketplaces. Need alignment on adapter lifecycle, bundle signing, and embargo timing for joint announcement.

maria: I can take lead on comms. Suggest we require signed bundle + manifest v1 + smoke tests for marketplace approval.

sophia: From orchestration (orch) side, we need a lifecycle hook for model swap during canary: `/orch/v1/rollout?bundle=...&strategy=gradient`  is that ok?

ryan: That endpoint works. Important to document health probe semantics so Gateways can trigger rollback. Proposed probe: 200 within 500ms for 5/5 checks.

devon: Partner Eng will publish a sample bundle layout and validator CLI. Minimal validate cmd:

```
rw-bundle validate ./orch-gateway-bundle.tgz --checks signing,manifest,smoke
```

We recommend ephemeral creds in harness demos.

maria: Embargo timing question  do partners want same-day marketplace + blog or stagger? Partners often prefer same-day but ops prefers stagger for telemetry.

kevin: Staggered: list on marketplace first, monitor 48-72h, then joint blog/webinar. Gives us time to burn in telemetry.

sophia: Also request explicit tracing keys: `rw.trace.partner_id`, `rw.trace.bundle_id`, and `rw.trace.request_id` so traces stitch across orch/gateway.

ryan: Will add tracing contract to the spec. Also flag: hardware partners may need a quantized artifact in bundle (`quantized/` dir) and a hardware-compat.json.

devon: Action items: 1) I'll drop sample bundle + validator PR (ETA Wed). 2) Sophia, add rollout endpoint doc. 3) Maria, draft embargo timeline and invite partners.

partner-bot: Reminder created: "Orch+Gateway marketplace preflight" Wed 10:00 PT (organizer: kevin).

maria: Please DM me LangChain SDK lead and gateway partner contact names to invite.

kevin: Thanks all  will post the initial artifacts to partners repo and share during Wed preflight.
